seeds.title: Limit widget composition to Dashboard Usage and Progress
seeds.statement: Widgets should be composition primitives only on Dashboard, Usage, and Orchestrator/Progress; Seams, Node Graph, Evidence, History, and Ledger remain fixed-purpose native tabs.
evidence: Recommended widget boundary allows widgets on Dashboard, Usage, and Orchestrator/Progress.
Recommended widget boundary excludes Seams, Node Graph, Evidence, History, and Ledger as widget-composed surfaces.

seeds.title: Treat non-Progress orchestrator tabs as non-widget canvases
seeds.statement: Non-Progress Orchestrator tabs may reuse internal view components, but should not expose generic add/remove/move/resize widget behavior.
evidence: Practical implication says excluded tabs can use reusable internals without generic widget-canvas behaviors.
Only Progress should behave as a widget canvas on the Orchestrator page.

seeds.title: Anchor widget contracts to stable projections
seeds.statement: Widgets should consume stable orchestrator projections and canonical record/query contracts rather than legacy event names or tier-specific objects.
evidence: Stable data-contract direction rejects direct dependence on TierChanged, IterationStart, and TierTree.
Suggested replacement is projection-oriented contracts like run summary, blocker projection, seam health, package activity, and recent major events.

seeds.title: Separate tab filters from widget presentation config
seeds.statement: Page/tab filters define canonical scope semantics while widget configuration should be limited to local presentation and emphasis controls.
evidence: Recommendation explicitly distinguishes page/tab filters from widget presentation config.
Acceptable widget config includes compactness, item count, sorting, and display toggles.
Risky widget config includes custom object models, custom state classification, and local blocked/completed semantics.

seeds.title: Define hostability as curated not universal
seeds.statement: Dashboard should host a curated subset of Progress and Usage widgets; deep inspection surfaces should remain non-hostable native tabs.
evidence: Hostability direction says many Progress widgets can also be hosted on Dashboard.
Recommendation says not every Orchestrator tab surface should become a portable widget.

seeds.title: Deprecate legacy orchestrator widget layout keys
seeds.statement: Keep widget layout persistence for dashboard, usage, and orchestrator progress while deprecating tier/evidence/history/ledger orchestrator widget layout keys in favor of fixed-tab view-state persistence.
evidence: Persistence impact proposes keeping layout keys for dashboard, usage, and orchestrator progress.
Persistence impact proposes removing/deprecating tier/evidence/history/ledger layout keys and replacing with view-state persistence (filters, selection, split positions, inspector state, last focus).

seeds.title: Adopt projection trust states across projection-backed surfaces
seeds.statement: Use shared projection trust states of current, refreshing, stale, degraded, and unavailable with explicit UI signaling for freshness and confidence.
evidence: Recommended trust-state model enumerates current/refreshing/stale/degraded/unavailable.
Fallback-view direction specifies trust badge, last-updated timestamp, degraded reason, and refresh/recover action.

seeds.title: Gate live actions by trust state
seeds.statement: Allow normal actions on current projections, permit cautious reads on refreshing/stale/degraded as appropriate, and restrict ambiguous live actions when trust is insufficient.
evidence: Action-gating direction recommends read-only navigation on stale/some degraded states with clear disclosure.
Action-gating direction requires refresh or runtime revalidation before sensitive live actions on stale data and tighter restrictions on degraded/unavailable states.

seeds.title: Use canonical record views as trust fallback
seeds.statement: When projection trust degrades, keep operational surfaces visible with clear trust UI and route deeper certainty needs to canonical record-backed History and Ledger views.
evidence: Fallback hierarchy says native projection view first, then explicit degraded context and recovery controls.
Fallback hierarchy and notes reinforce History as chronological durable story and Ledger as exact record inspection.

seeds.title: Resolve planning-doc contradictions with rewrite direction
seeds.statement: Widget_System and Orchestrator_Page need explicit updates to align with seam/package rewrite boundaries and hostability rules so deep inspection tabs are not treated as widget pages.
evidence: Contradictions/gaps section states Widget_System remains tier-first and overly widgetized.
Contradictions/gaps section notes Orchestrator_Page still describes Tiers as widget-based and carries older defaults.
